# Vendored front-end assets

These files are checked in so the dashboard has no runtime dependency on a CDN
or any other network resource.

| Asset | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css` | 5.3.8 | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap | MIT |
| `bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.min.css` | 1.13.1 | https://github.com/twbs/icons | MIT |
| `bootstrap-icons/fonts/*` | 1.13.1 | https://github.com/twbs/icons | MIT |

Both projects include their copyright and license notices in the file headers, and
their full MIT licenses are stored next to the assets as `LICENSE`.
